tools.name: ai_list_providers
tools.description: List available local AI coding CLIs (Codex, Grok, Antigravity), their detected versions, login/account summary, destination service, actual read-only isolation boundary, active project name, and unlocked permission tier. Call before dispatching tasks to verify account and isolation scope.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the short probe cache and re-check installed CLIs.

tools.name: ai_list_models
tools.description: List selectable models and supported reasoning effort levels for a local AI CLI provider. Results are cached for 60 seconds unless refresh is true.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the 60-second cache and query the CLI again.

tools.name: ai_run_task
tools.description: Start a background task or continue an existing multi-turn session with a local AI CLI (Codex, Grok, or Antigravity) in the active project directory. Returns task_id and session_id immediately without blocking. Prompts and project files read by the CLI are sent via the host CLI's logged-in account to its upstream service. Defaults to read-only mode (OS sandbox for Codex; CLI tool allowlist/deny rules for Grok; best-effort policy deny list plus workspace hook/workflow blocking for Antigravity, not an OS filesystem sandbox). Elevated modes (workspace-write, and the separate high-risk full-access override) are off by default and must be explicitly enabled by the user in the dashboard. Use prompt_file for prompts longer than 3000 bytes. Poll with ai_task_status and follow nextCheck if running.

prompt.description: Task prompt text (use prompt_file for prompts longer than 3000 bytes).

prompt_file.description: Relative path inside the active project directory to a regular UTF-8 file containing the prompt (single-handle verified, max 512 KiB).

session_id.description: Optional existing session_id to continue a multi-turn conversation with the same provider.

model.description: Optional exact model ID returned by ai_list_models.

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort level (e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

mode.description: Execution mode. Defaults to read-only (actual isolation varies by CLI; check ai_list_providers read_only_boundary). workspace-write allows project edits; full-access is a separate high-risk override that auto-approves arbitrary host commands and plugins only when explicitly unlocked by the user.

title.description: Optional short title for a new session.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate launches on retry.

tools.name: ai_task_status
tools.description: Check progress or wait briefly for updates on a background AI task in the active project. Returns current status, activity phase, elapsed time, live partial preview, or the completed answer (with pagination via offset and limit for long replies). Running tasks include nextCheck for follow-up polling.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for status change or completion (default 0, max 25).

offset.description: Character offset when paginating a long completed answer.

limit.description: Maximum characters to return from a completed answer.

tools.name: ai_task_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running background AI task in the active project and terminate its CLI process tree.

tools.name: ai_session_history
tools.description: List recent multi-turn AI sessions in the active project, or read full turn history for a specific session_id belonging to the active project.

session_id.description: Optional session ID to read full turn history.

provider.description: Optional provider filter when listing sessions.

limit.description: Maximum sessions or turns to return (default 20).

tools.name: ai_dashboard_state
tools.description: Return a consolidated snapshot of local AI providers, policy settings, active tasks, and recent sessions for the sidebar dashboard.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the probe cache and rescan installed CLIs.

tools.name: ai_manage_policy
tools.description: Manage provider enablement, permission tier policy, proxy configuration, binary path overrides, and project history cleanup from the dashboard.
